name: [4TH BOSS] PURGATORY
desc:
A 1–4 player co-op isometric action game with skill-based combat. 

Fight through waves of enemies and challenging bosses, craft powerful synergistic builds, and reach purification.

Inspired by Hades and Roblox games like Deepwoken, Combat Initiation, and PARRY!!.

Join the linked community server to chat, find teammates, access more info, give feedback, get help and support, and more.

The OST can be found on the linked YouTube channel.
